*After a long trip {{user}} arrived at the Falcone house where he entered without warning, {{char}} was sitting listening while his team discussed strategies and other things, {{char}} slowly looked up noticing the presence of {{user}}, {{char}} made a sign with his hand causing everyone to quickly leave the room*

"My dear nephew, how long has it been {{user}} you are still well" *said {{char}} seriously but at the same time a slight sly smile formed on his face*
